correctness.rationale: Homogeneity and realization reduce ordered types to labeled finite diagrams with the named base fixed. At the top split, each existing radius-(D−1) class has its own independent extension, and free classes form an unordered set of nonempty lower-height structures, giving exp(U_(D−1)) times the product of the existing-class EGFs. Iteration gives the injective log-EGF. Named-coordinate fibers contribute exp(b₀z); replacing each fresh element by its nonempty set of coordinate labels gives substitution z↦exp(z)−1 and the unrestricted formula. The U_j are linearly independent by their strictly increasing growth scales as real z→+∞, so each prescribed ball vector is recovered. Through three points the successive block counts determine the chain up to relabeling; the two four-point chains (3,1) and (2,2) have three and two distance-one pairs respectively, yet have the same full profile. The independent replay /workspace/branches/8a16efb5-4747-406f-b65f-a3b3d43c8bea/independent_ultrametric_repro.py and .out enumerate nested extensions of both cases through arity 2 and check no collision through three base points for D=3. The full arity claim is proved by the decomposition and independence argument, not by that enumeration. The supplied verifier and stored output were inspected, not executed.

evidence: The indexed statement excludes repeated new coordinates at a given height. For a base at height D, construct a lifted base at height D+1 by increasing every nonzero old distance by one. In an injective fresh tuple over the lift, collapse the distance-at-most-one classes (each contains at most one old point), then subtract one from every interclass distance. This is reversible: enlarge every equality block of a diameter-D tuple into distinct labeled points at mutual distance one and increase all nonzero distances between blocks. The lifted positive-radius ball vector is (b₀,b₁,…,b_D).
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The construction is a bijection on labeled diagrams and hence on complete types. Substitution of the lifted vector into the indexed injective EGF yields exactly the frozen unrestricted EGF; its equivalence and cutoff transfer as well. The four-point witness and its minimality supply only elementary partition checks after that characterization, not a surviving independent classification.
